title: A Clinical Trial of Tirzepatide (LY3298176) in Subjects With Overweight or Obesity and PCOS-related Ovarian Dysfunction (PERIODS)
official: A Clinical Trial of Tirzepatide (LY3298176) in Subjects With Overweight or Obesity and PCOS-related Ovarian Dysfunction (PERIODS)
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate that tirzepatide in its maximum tolerated dose is superior to placebo for improvement of ovarian dysfunction as defined by menstrual irregularity in overweight or obesity-related PCOS
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Written informed consent to participate in this clinical trial in accordance with local regulations and the ethical review board governing this clinical trial
2. Biochemical signs of hyperandrogenism with total testosterone in upper 95th Percentile AND free androgen index (FAI) > ULN and/or clinical signs of hyperandrogenism
3. Hormonal contraceptive naïve or not on hormonal contraceptives six months prior to screening, willing to be without hormonal contraceptives for the duration of the clinical trial and to perform safe alternate contraception (barrier methods) during the 72-week IMP intake period and 30 days after the last dose of IMP
4. Subject is motivated, capable, and willing to self-inject IMP, as required for this protocol
5. Subject is motivated, capable, and willing to follow trial procedures for the duration of the clinical trial, including, but not limited to lifestyle, dietary and exercise advice
6. Subject is motivated, capable, and willing to complete trial diaries and required questionnaires
7. Females aged 18 – 45 years of childbearing potential
8. At least 3 years post-menarche and premenopausal
9. BMI ≥ 27 kg/m²
10. Previous diagnosis of PCOS
11. Oligomenorrhea or secondary amenorrhea with irregular periods (defined as cycle length less than 21 or more than 35 days or < 8 cycles per year); within the last 10 years (if currently receiving hormonal contraceptive treatment) OR over the last year in the absence of hormonal contraceptive treatment
Exclusion criteria:
1. Subjects without legal capacity who are unable to understand the nature, scope, significance and consequences of this clinical trial
2. Prior diagnosis of diabetes mellitus other forms than type 2
3. In case of diabetes mellitus type 2: on DPP-4 inhibitors, GLP-1R agonist, a dual/triple incretin agonist (up to 6 months prior to screening)
4. In case of diabetes mellitus type 2: on sulfonylureas or insulin (basal and/or bolus)
5. In case of diabetes mellitus type 2: with uncontrolled diabetes (HbA1c > 8.5%)
6. In case of diabetes mellitus type 2: with non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy requiring acute treatment
7. In case of diabetes mellitus type 2: with diabetic maculopathy
8. Current or prior treatment (up to 6 months prior to screening) with GLP-1R agonist or a dual incretin agonist for obesity or other indications
9. Use of inositol formulations (up to 6 months prior to screening)
10. Congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH, classic and non-classic forms)
11. Thyroid, pituitary, and/or adrenal disease (if not appropriately treated)
12. Subjects with a physical or psychiatric condition which at the investigator’s discretion may put the subject at risk, may confound the trial results, or may interfere with the subject’s participation in this clinical trial
13. Hyperprolactinaemia
14. Known history of benign intrauterine lesions
15. Hysterectomy
16. Known history of hypersensitivity against tirzepatide or excipients
17. Known personal or family history of medullary thyroid cancer or subjects with Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2)
18. Elevated calcitonin levels as determined by the laboratory during screening: ≥ 20 ng/L, if eGFR ≥ 60 mL/min/1.73 m2 ≥ 35 ng/L, if eGFR < 60 mL/min/1.73 m2
19. Known secondary cause of obesity (i.e., Cushing syndrome) or monogenetic or syndromic forms of obesity (i.e., melanocortin 4 receptor deficiency or Prader Willi Syndrome)
20. Known history of acute or chronic pancreatitis
21. Previous or planned bariatric surgery or endoscopic and/or device-based therapy for obesity
22. Simultaneous participation in another clinical trial, or participation in a clinical trial taking an investigational product, up to 30 days after last IMP in-take in that clinical trial
23. Known or persistent abuse of medication, drugs or alcohol
24. History of an active or untreated malignancy or being in remission from a clinically significant malignancy for less than 5 years
25. Prior diagnosis of severe renal impairment or measured as estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) < 30 mL/min/1.73 m² during screening
26. Acute or chronic hepatitis, signs and symptoms of any other liver disease other than non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, or alanine aminotransferase (ALT) level > 3.0 X the upper limit of normal, as determined by the laboratory during screening
27. History of gastric emptying abnormality (e.g., gastroparesis, gastric outlet obstruction or chronic dependence on drugs that significantly affect gastric emptying)
28. Current (positive pregnancy test, e.g., ß-HCG test in urine / serum) or planned pregnancy during the 72-week IMP intake period and 30 days after the last dose of IMP, or nursing women
